### Isaac's Final Breath
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/isaacs-final-breath
Passage: Genesis 35:27-29
Points:
- Isaac's recorded death concludes his generational narrative and shifts the biblical focus toward Jacob's sons.
- Highlighting the burial here showcases the peaceful reconciliation achieved between Jacob and Esau.
- Isaac died holding to God's covenant promises despite not seeing their complete earthly realization.
- Choosing burial in Hebron demonstrated enduring faith that Canaan remained their promised inheritance.
- Believers across every generation are called to trust God's word even when fulfillment remains in the future.
